device: Amazon Fire TV Stick 2nd generation / AFTT / tank
context: Original pre-release prototype, one device. PC-triggered Home key to Luncher focused window. Includes ADB input overhead; not a cold-boot benchmark.
resolution: Window focus polled at about 80 ms plus ADB round trips; not frame-accurate physical remote latency.
limitations: One device; not a benchmark of final public builds on multiple models
Accelerator requires reactivation after a full reboot
